scope_note: The 330-1100 official elastic contract is component-selective: a run is valid only when every selected active component covers the requested wavelength. Pure water, CDOM, AHN mineral TSM, atmosphere/aerosol and six gases cover the full range; Chl-linked detritus currently limits Chl>0 constituent runs to 350-850 nm.
